live_test: Real query against gis2.arlingtontx.gov (needs a User-Agent header -- a bare urllib request with no UA gets HTTP 403, already handled by live_self_test.py's shared http_get) returned live rows, e.g. '340 E STEPHENS STREET Bldg', MainUse='Apartments (3+ dwelling units)', WORKDESC='New Construction', issued 2026-09-01 (epoch ms 1788363343000), $65,000,000 declared value; '300 E STEPHENS STREET' and four '9582/9586/9588 EDEN ROAD BLDG' rows also returned live.
notes: No unit-count field and no owner/name field on this layer (fields are  -- checked live via the layer's own ?f=json metadata) -- units stay None ('Units: not public yet'), find_upcoming's type-match fallback (MainUse LIKE 'Apartments%') is what keeps these rows since there's no unit count to gate on. FOLDERNAME doubles as both name and address (it's a street address string like '340 E STEPHENS STREET Bldg'), same fallback pattern as Gilbert/Phoenix.
